en: Oh, I guess I should introduce myself.
My name's <CLT=cltSTRONG>Makoto<CLT=typeNORMAL>.

I don't have any talents or anything.
I'm just a regular teenager...
This boring-looking person is me...
See, even the way I look is normal.

Getting into an elite school like this 
was just the start of my bad luck.

I can't keep up with my classmates' 
conversations or the teachers' lectures...

I'm just treated like <CLT=cltSTRONG>empty space<CLT=typeNORMAL> in the
classroom.
At home, my parents are constantly on my case...
Honestly...I'm fed up...
I want to run away from my daily life...
I want to run away and just forget all this...

I want to run away...and run away...and 
run away and run away and run away.
But I'm okay!

I have a reason to live!
I've got something to look forward to!
That's why I'm gonna be okay!
Thanks for the courage!

Thanks for giving me something 
to get totally obsessed with!
Thanks for the strength to keep going!

I'll keep on rooting for you, so please
keep trying your best!
And—!
One day, I'll also—!
Kyaaaah!
Wh-What happened!?

The school building blew up!
Wh-What happened!?
Hey, over there!

<CLT=cltMIND>I turned my head to where
Maki was pointing...
K-Keebo!?
Keebo! What are you doing!?
You're flying! Is it magic!?

I don't know what he's planning, but it looks
like he's attacking the school indiscriminately.

We need to hurry and stop him... We'll get
caught up in this mess if we don't.
But how do we stop him?

We have to talk to him!
We can get him to come down!

It's dangerous, but...let's go to the courtyard
and try to get his attention.
Y-Yeah! You're right!

<CLT=cltMIND>Confused by the situation unfolding in front
of us, we ran to the center of the courtyard.
Eeeeek! It's like a battlefield!

W-We need to get his attention!
Get him to come down!
Keeeebooooo! Come here!
Are you trying to get us killed!?

Please, Keebo!
Come down and talk to us!

<CLT=cltMIND>I shouted out to Keebo, who finally
came to a halt midair...
<CLT=cltMIND>and then slowly flew down to us.
...Here he comes.
Y-Yeah...
Did you call for me?

Please keep it brief.
I have other matters I must attend to.
Other matters?
I'm going to end the killing game...
End the killing game...?

To do that...I must destroy the Ultimate
Academy for Gifted Juveniles.
D-Destroy it!?

The killing game cannot go on if I destroy
this school in its entirety.
So that's why...you have that weapon?
What's with that weapon and the jet pack?
I obtained this equipment from my lab.
You had equipment like that...in your lab?

I made some modifications to drastically
improve their power output and functionality.

Since when have you been able to do that?
You didn't level up or anything, right?
Did...something happen?

Didn't...you say that you didn't
want to use anything from the lab?
Th-That's right! You don't like looking sci-fi!

Yes...I wanted to be treated like a real human.
A creature of flesh and blood like you all.

But I no longer have the luxury of clinging
to that wish anymore!

My course is clear! I must destroy this
academy and end this killing game!

H-Hold on! If you do something like that...
we'll all die, too, y'know!?

There's no oxygen in the outside world...
There are no living things...

We're only able to survive because we're 
<CLT=cltSTRONG>inside this spaceship<CLT=typeNORMAL>, y'know?
Th-That's right! Are you trying to kill us, too!?
If my actions result in your deaths...so be it.
"So be it"?

Monokuma told us that <CLT=cltSTRONG>despair<CLT=typeNORMAL> is our only
choice.
That <CLT=cltSTRONG>hope<CLT=typeNORMAL>...does not exist here.
And unfortunately, he is right.

As long as this killing game continues, only
<CLT=cltSTRONG>despair<CLT=typeNORMAL> awaits us.
Wait...we still have hope.

Our hope is...everyone here.
Our friends who are still alive.

Y-Yeah... If we all work together, 
even this killing game will—
It will not stop. It will never stop.

And even if we did manage to stop this killing
game and escape, where would we go?

Earth is destroyed, humanity is extinct...
We have no home to return to.
Th-That...might be true, but...

Monokuma is right.
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Despair<CLT=typeNORMAL> is all we have here.

We simply do not have the power to change
the <CLT=cltSTRONG>outside world<CLT=typeNORMAL> on our own.

All we can do now is refuse to submit
to <CLT=cltSTRONG>despair<CLT=typeNORMAL>!

And you would be willing to let all of
us die to accomplish that?

That is a far better alternative than allowing
Monokuma to continue the killing game.
A-Are you...serious!?

Kaito and Kokichi gave their lives to end
this killing game...

We should follow their example! We should be
willing to give our lives to end this killing game!

...Is that what your <CLT=cltSTRONG>inner voice<CLT=typeNORMAL> is telling
you to do?
No...I can no longer hear that voice.
You can't hear it anymore?

For some reason...my inner voice has gone
silent. This decision is my will, my choice.

I've chosen to modify myself and destroy
this academy.

We can never submit to <CLT=cltSTRONG>despair<CLT=typeNORMAL>! Because
we are students of Hope's Peak Academy!
No...that's wrong.
...Wrong?

Because there might still be <CLT=cltSTRONG>hope<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
There might still be a place to call home.
And what are you basing that claim on?
...Nothing.
I just have a feeling.

Just a feeling...?
You sound like <CLT=cltSTRONG>that idiot<CLT=typeNORMAL> right now.
...Kaito said so.

It's just like Kokichi said! If this game's rules
matter so much, someone's watching.

There can be no killing game
without an audience.

<CLT=cltSTRONG>Hope's Peak Academy<CLT=typeNORMAL> was the same way.
It was a killing game made for an audience.
This game must be the same way.

Someone is watching this somewhere...
There's someone left.
There's still a possibility!

True, we cannot say there is absolutely no
possibility. But even a mere possibility—
That possibility is our <CLT=cltSTRONG>hope<CLT=cltNORMAL>!
...What?

We haven't investigated everything.
There are still a lot of mysteries in this school!

If there are still questions to answer,
then we haven't found the truth.

And that means...we can't give up!
We can't give up before we reach the truth!
...Spoken like a true <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Detective<CLT=typeNORMAL>.

Very well. I shall cooperate with your attempt
to stop this killing game your way.
Keebo!

But you have until dawn.
I will not wait any longer than that.
Until dawn?

Though dawn here is simply an illusion
projected onto the dome...
If you cannot stop the killing game by dawn...

I will destroy the Ultimate Academy and
end the killing game mysel—
Puhuhu... You're gonna end what now?

*sigh* Didn't I tell you? It's impossible
to end the killing game.
Cuz the killing game is forever eternal!
H-He's back!

Attempting to destroy this precious academy
is more than a violation of school regulations.
It's an act of mutiny!

So what!? You are sorely mistaken if you
think I will allow this to continue!

Huh? Is the robot malfunctioning? He must
be—why else would he try to defy me?

Then let's kill him until he dies from it!
Hell yeah!

Ripping a robot apart isn't gory at all, so
I can go all out this time!
Pops! Can we kill him!? Please!?

Puhuhu... They're so brazen cuz they don't
have any hair downstairs.
...Well, any last words?
Eeeek! Th-They're all in battle mode!

This place is dangerous. You all need to get
out of here.
Keebo, are you okay!?

Shuichi... Please find this "<CLT=cltSTRONG>truth<CLT=typeNORMAL>" that you
mentioned earlier while I stall them.

It's all in your hands now!
Now go!
Alright!

Never forgive rulebreakers! Anyone who
messes with the killing game must die!
Exisals, assemble!

No, I won't let you run amok anymore!
This killing game is over!

In the name of Hope's Peak Academy, the
symbol of <CLT=cltSTRONG>hope<CLT=typeNORMAL> itself...

I will destroy the Ultimate Academy, and
bring down this monument to <CLT=cltSTRONG>despair<CLT=typeNORMAL>!

<CLT=cltMIND>That's how it began.
In the war between Keebo and the Exisals...
<CLT=cltMIND>the Ultimate Academy became a battlefield.
